reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 3 points better, in a game of about 239 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Grizzlies (revenge).
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 60 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 212 and 260 total points.
